title: Spiraling Umbrella Agent
description: A blonde woman in a black suit and white shirt floats dynamically in the center of a swirling vortex, holding a large red and white umbrella in one hand and a red device in the other. The scene features a cosmic starry center, floating paper lanterns, red spider lilies, pink petals, a twisted glowing tree, and floating handguns, with text ribbons reading 'SPIRALING' and 'SEVERANCE'.
